item.title: What happens when a GPU reads memory
item.description:
📝 warp coalescer L115 nsTLB crossbar L2127 nscontroller DRAM255 nsSMdieboard From the warp to the L1 cache Let’s start with the instruction. To load the data itself, we first must go get that address from those registers. A shared-memory load taking its address from a register takes 24 cycles from issue to first use, and the same load with the address as an immediate takes 23.

item.title: When the shortage is the strategy
item.description:
📝 Describing prices that rise like rockets, but fall like feathers. This represents fewer sales, but higher prices on fewer units. Each with its own supply shock, each with the same result: prices went up, profits hit records, and when the constraint eased, the prices stayed.
🔗 Read more: https://nooneshappy.com/article/when-the-shortage-is-the-strategy/
